notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes: Looking forward to a great year. Happy new year everyone!

notes.title: Weeklong sales coming up.
notes.notes: It's been two months since launch! Steam doesn't make it easy for newbies to find the little button that allows you to opt into the weeklong sales event, but we finally found it. Look out for the 34% weeklong sales starting on September 10th.
